feature_name: Metadata preservation controls for Cloud Storage transfers
summary: Storage Transfer Service now lets you choose whether to retain or discard object metadata, including ACLs, CMEK settings, temporary holds, and creation time, during Cloud Storage bucket transfers.
extended_definition: Storage Transfer Service now lets you choose whether to retain or discard object metadata, including ACLs, CMEK settings, temporary holds, and creation time, during Cloud Storage bucket transfers.
